verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a desktop coding-agent app, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a scheduler, cron-style triggers, or recurring workflows. The evidence covers only interactive per-chat agent use, model selection, skills/MCP plugins, git operations, and app updates, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
